tier1.text: Cilia are short, hair-like structures that move substances along a cell's outer surface. In the airways, cilia beat constantly, sweeping dust, mucus and bacteria away from the lungs. In the fallopian tubes, beating cilia move egg cells from the ovary toward the uterus. Cilia are built from microtubules, which are small hollow tubes.

sentences.text: Cilia are short, hair-like structures that move substances along a cell's outer surface.

quotes.quote: cilium: (plural = cilia) short, hair-like structure that extends from the plasma membrane in large numbers and functions to move an entire cell or move substances along the cell's outer surface
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: In the airways, cilia beat constantly, sweeping dust, mucus and bacteria away from the lungs.

quotes.quote: Cilia move rhythmically; they beat constantly, moving waste materials such as dust, mucus, and bacteria upward through the airways, away from the lungs and toward the mouth.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: In the fallopian tubes, beating cilia move egg cells from the ovary toward the uterus.

quotes.quote: Beating cilia on cells in the female fallopian tubes move egg cells from the ovary towards the uterus.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: Microtubules also make up two types of cellular appendages important for motion: cilia and flagella.

quotes.quote: As their name implies, microtubules are small hollow tubes.
